chunks: That is how We reward those who do good.

key_terms.الْمُحْسِنِينَ: those who do good / the righteous

ai.seo_question: How does God reward those who do good?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff, this verse underscores the divine justice that rewards the righteous not merely proportionally but with abundant grace, reinforcing the theme of steadfastness in battle and faith. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a promise of spiritual elevation for those who maintain piety amidst trials, linking moral excellence to ultimate success in the Hereafter.
